title: Oscar®-Qualifying HollyShorts Film Festival 2022
deck: Where it started: laurels, social and a podcast.
lede: The first of five HollyShorts editions. In 2022, as a designer, Dalton Corr made the festival's graphics and social media, from the official selection laurel to the podcast.
challenge: The 18th HollyShorts Film Festival took place at the TCL Chinese Theatres in Hollywood in August 2022, and needed its graphic design and social media.
work: The work covered the festival's graphics and social media: the 2022 official selection laurel that every selected film carries onto its own poster, an 18 edition graphic for social, and the campaign for the festival's podcast, “F Is for Film,” in black and in white.
It was the first year with the festival, and the start of five. A year later came the role of art director.
system: “F Is for Film,” in black and white.
credits: Dalton Corr: graphic design and social media
